steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (let i = n - 5; i < n; i++) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 5
const n = project.elements.length; for (let i = n - 3; i < n; i++) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 3
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'Current'; e.dataType = 'WEATHER_CURRENT'; return e.name
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'High temp'; e.dataType = 'WEATHER_HIGH'; return e.name
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'Low temp'; e.dataType = 'WEATHER_LOW'; return e.name
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'Sunrise'; e.dataType = 'SUN_RISE'; return e.name
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'Sunset'; e.dataType = 'SUN_SET'; return e.name
const e = project.elements[project.elements.length - 1]; e.name = 'Humidity'; e.dataType = 'HUMIDITY'; return e.name
const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === 'Month'); e.isCharacter = true; e.part = 'month'; e.images = await genLabelSet(e, 'month'); return e.images.length
let n = 0; for (const nm of ['Sunrise', 'Sunset']) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); e.dot = await genUnit('scolon', ':', { style: digitStyleOf(e.images) }); n++ } return n
document.getElementById('btnPruneImages').click(); return project.images.length + ' images after pruning'

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Day","Month","Weekday"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gDate'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gWeather = 'Weather'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Current","High temp","Low temp","Sunrise","Sunset","Humidity"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gWeather'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gActivity = 'Activity bars'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Move bar","Exercise bar","Stand bar"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gActivity'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gReadings = 'Readings'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Steps","Heart rate","Battery"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gReadings'; n++ } } return n
project.groups = project.groups || {}; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name) && e.group) project.groups[e.group] = 'Clock AOD' } return 1
themeIdx = 3; render(); return themeIdx
